dedupe_keys.name: climate indices drought and wetness calculations

description: Climate Indices is James Adams and contributors' Python implementation of drought and climate-monitoring indices, derived from NIDIS, NCEI and NOAA code. It computes SPI, SPEI, evapotranspiration and Palmer-family measures, with additional precipitation and wetness indices. Inputs are temperature or precipitation series and index-specific calibration settings; outputs are index time series or gridded arrays. Geographic coverage, period and resolution follow the supplied climate data. Source is free under BSD-3-Clause, with the earlier public-domain lineage documented in the licence. A limitation is that accumulated wetness indicates flood potential, not actual inundation, and the xarray interface is marked beta. Climate Indices can prepare drought and water-stress scenarios for infrastructure simulations. ERA5 (data-era5-reanalysis) is related meteorological context, without a tested input recipe here. No climate data, index arrays or executable environment were downloaded.
licence: BSD-3-Clause; earlier NOAA-derived code has public-domain provenance
